data.content: LATE HIVE-FLOW VERIFIER ADDENDUM (task-cc5a64e5-dd4b-4abe-956b-8f56dded5e88): independent codex-cli verifier also returned BOUNCE. Additional must-review/fix items: (2) malformed/tampered read paths report deadLetter=true/deadLetters[] but never durably copy/move the bad record into .hive-flow/messages/deadletter, despite the store contract exposing a deadletter directory and deadLetterMessage helper; add durable dead-letter persistence or a deliberately named API boundary with tests. (3) exported setDeliveryState accepts any DeliveryState and writes it directly after a successful read; this is too easy to misuse and weakens the derived-state invariant. Restrict/rename/internalize it or require transition-specific evidence, with tests. Primary must-fix remains ackMessage false-success on absent/corrupt records.
